Episode #4 🍠: Soft Sweet Potato Mini Bars for Toddlers   These are the SOFTEST toddler snacks, naturally sweet, soft, and made with REAL food. Perfect for calm snack moments and happy little tummies.   Ingredients: - 1/2 cup sweet potato purée   - 1/3 cup soaked figs   - 1/3 cup apple compote   - 1/3 cup almonds   - 1 tbsp olive oil   - 1/4 tsp cinnamon   Instructions: 1️⃣ Blend all ingredients until smooth   2️⃣ Spread into a pan   3️⃣ Bake at 180°C / 356°F for 20 min   4️⃣ Cool, cut into mini bars, enjoy!   No refined sugar, no junk, just soft, healthy snacks your toddler will love 💛   #ToddlerSnacks #SnackTherapy #HealthyToddlerTreats #SweetPotatoSnack
